The path SLOPES throughout and never gaps - a hill slopes, it does not gap. Closing at +60 against a session peak of +70 puts the close at roughly 86% of the session's up-excursion, i.e. near the high, which is the continuation signature that seeds the carry handoff.
reasoning.why_this_day_is_a_useful_library_entry: The conditions-to-shape pair this day contributes is: a live BUILDING forward weather catalyst whose delivery clock sits 3-6 days out, standing on an uncrowded positioning book and a quiet range regime, with the day's OWN forcing at the low of the forward window. The shape that conjunction should produce is what I have drawn - a shallow overnight-to-midday grind up on successive warm model cycles, a settle/expiry-related trim, and a firm close - NOT a large directional day. If a future session matches those conditions, the retrievable lesson is that the move belongs to the following sessions and the Friday's job is to carry length, which is why the handoff below matters more than the +80.
